A bill for an act relating to natural resources; exempting disabled veterans from watercraft fees; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 86B.415, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 86B.415, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 12.+]

[+Disabled veterans.+]

[+(a) The watercraft license fee for watercraft owned by a veteran with a 100 percent service-connected disability is $0. A veteran with a 100 percent service-connected disability must not be charged a fee to register a watercraft or to transfer or duplicate a watercraft license and is not required to pay a watercraft surcharge or registrar's fee under this section. +]

[+(b) For purposes of this subdivision, "veteran with a 100 percent service-connected disability" means a veteran, as defined in section 197.447, who provides satisfactory evidence to the commissioner of natural resources demonstrating that the veteran has a 100 percent service-connected disability rating as adjudicated by the United States Department of Veterans Affairs or the retirement board of one of the several branches of the armed forces. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; exempting disabled veterans from watercraft fees; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 86B.415, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 86B.415, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 12.

Disabled veterans.

(a) The watercraft license fee for watercraft owned by a veteran with a 100 percent service-connected disability is $0. A veteran with a 100 percent service-connected disability must not be charged a fee to register a watercraft or to transfer or duplicate a watercraft license and is not required to pay a watercraft surcharge or registrar's fee under this section.

(b) For purposes of this subdivision, "veteran with a 100 percent service-connected disability" means a veteran, as defined in section 197.447, who provides satisfactory evidence to the commissioner of natural resources demonstrating that the veteran has a 100 percent service-connected disability rating as adjudicated by the United States Department of Veterans Affairs or the retirement board of one of the several branches of the armed forces.
additions: (a) The watercraft license fee for watercraft owned by a veteran with a 100 percent service-connected disability is $0. A veteran with a 100 percent service-connected disability must not be charged a fee to register a watercraft or to transfer or duplicate a watercraft license and is not required to pay a watercraft surcharge or registrar's fee under this section.

(b) For purposes of this subdivision, "veteran with a 100 percent service-connected disability" means a veteran, as defined in section 197.447, who provides satisfactory evidence to the commissioner of natural resources demonstrating that the veteran has a 100 percent service-connected disability rating as adjudicated by the United States Department of Veterans Affairs or the retirement board of one of the several branches of the armed forces.
